facts.text: I want to book a tennis court at the local community center for this Saturday.
I played tennis with my colleague Rachel at the local community center last weekend.
I want to get more practice playing tennis with Rachel.
I want to book the tennis court first to make sure I can get a good time slot.
I have been trying to improve my volleys.
I am thinking of booking the tennis court for 10 am.
I usually do a warm-up before playing as part of my routine.
I have been doing forehand volley drills where my partner hits a forehand and I try to volley it back.
The forehand volley drills help me develop my reaction time and hand-eye coordination.
I have been working on keeping my racquet in front of the ball.
I have been using a lighter grip pressure.
Keeping my racquet in front of the ball and using a lighter grip pressure helps me be more precise and consistent with my volleys.
I should work on my backhand volleys too.
I have been playing in a doubles tournament at the club recently.
My doubles team made it to the semi-finals.
I am planning to play in another tournament next month.
I am trying to get as much practice as possible to prepare for the next tournament.
